review: I like that each stage owns one mechanic and Gauntlet remixes all of them; that is a correct structure. The curve is the problem. Saw Mill at stage 3 passes only 37% of mid-skill players and kills them at 84%, next to the goal, which is harder than the finale. Spring Loaded at stage 6 is then the easiest stage, and its saws sit high off-screen where a spring throws me blind. Ferry Lines gives all three skill levels the same 12 seconds, so the ferries set the pace, not me. Laser Gate teaches well with its dotted telegraph. First Steps kills 29 of 100 with spikes, which is much for a tutorial.
best: Laser Gate: readable telegraphed beams, deaths spread evenly, and a pass rate that fits its late position.
worst: Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3, with moving saws that kill next to the goal.
